leadText: Atsuko Enomoto (Japanese: 榎本温子 Enomoto Atsuko) is a Japanese voice actress for .
plainText:
Atsuko Enomoto (Japanese: 榎本温子 Enomoto Atsuko) is a Japanese voice actress for .

==Biography==
Enomoto was born on November 1, 1979, in , , as the youngest of three sisters. She became a voice actress while she was still in high school, and also pursued a singing career. Enomoto had been affiliated with the talent agency until her departure in 2015. She was married to fellow voice actress from March 2016 to August 2018. Enomoto has occasionally voiced characters for the during the and , and her best known role during that time was Solana. She briefly returned during , voicing Beatrice, a character of the day.
